scenes.title: A Multi-Planetary Future
scenes.subtitle: SpaceX and the Journey to Mars
scenes.narration: For all of human history, our existence has been tied to a single world. But the future is calling us outward. SpaceX isn't just building rockets; they are building the bridge to a multi-planetary future—and our next destination is the Red Planet.

scenes.title: Meet the Starship
scenes.subtitle: The Vessel of the Future
scenes.narration: Meet the Starship. Standing tall and entirely reusable, this massive spacecraft is engineered to carry up to one hundred people and critical supplies at a time. Powered by next-generation Raptor engines, it is the cornerstone of interplanetary travel.

How far is the leap? While planetary orbits constantly shift, the average journey aboard a SpaceX transport vessel will take approximately 7 months. Thanks to in-space refueling and advanced propulsion, this voyage is no longer science fiction—it is the next frontier.

scenes.heading: Hurdles of Martian Colonization
content_points: Extreme radiation beyond Earth's magnetic field
scenes.narration: Of course, colonizing a new world doesn't come easy. The pioneers of Mars will face monumental hurdles: extreme radiation beyond Earth’s magnetic field, a thin, unbreathable atmosphere, and brutal, freezing temperatures. Overcoming these challenges is the ultimate test of human ingenuity.

scenes.heading: Building a Self-Sustaining Civilization
content_points: Harvesting ice for water and life support
Producing rocket fuel on-site for return trips
scenes.narration: The ultimate goal isn't just visiting—it's staying. By utilizing local resources, harvesting ice for water, and producing fuel on-site, early habitats will grow into thriving, self-sustaining cities. Mars is waiting, and humanity is ready to take its next giant leap.
